notices.title: Not connected
notices.reason: The DSPi is not connected, or it went away.
notices.action: Connect the DSPi and try again.

notices.title: Transfer failed
notices.reason: The DSPi did not answer as expected.
notices.action: Try again. If it keeps failing, reconnect the DSPi.

notices.title: Change refused
notices.reason: The DSPi refused the request.
notices.action: Check the value and try again.

notices.title: Not a valid value
notices.reason: A value was out of range or not understood.
notices.action: Check the value and try again.

notices.title: Not available
notices.reason: The connected firmware does not have this feature.
notices.action: Update the DSPi's firmware to use it.

notices.title: Read-only
notices.reason: This firmware's settings can be shown but not changed in this version.
notices.action: Update the app or the DSPi's firmware to make changes.

notices.title: Another console is applying changes
notices.reason: The hub lets one console change the DSPi at a time.
notices.action: Wait a moment and try again.

notices.title: Not allowed
notices.reason: This console's role on the hub does not allow that change.
notices.action: Ask an Admin of the hub for the Control role.

notices.title: DSPi Link failed
notices.reason: The connection to the hub failed.
notices.action: Check the hub and the network, then connect again.

notices.title: Wrong PIN
notices.reason: The hub did not accept the PIN.
notices.action: Check the PIN the hub shows and enter it again.

notices.title: Too many attempts
notices.reason: The hub refuses new attempts for a while.
notices.action: Wait a minute, then try again.

notices.title: Hub busy
notices.reason: The hub has no free session.
notices.action: Close another console's connection, or try again later.

notices.title: A different hub
notices.reason: The hub at this address is not the one paired before.
notices.action: Pair with this hub again if it replaced the old one.

notices.title: The hub refused the connection
notices.reason: The hub did not let this console in.
notices.action: Check the hub's settings, then connect again.

notices.title: The hub did not answer
notices.reason: No answer came from the hub in time.
notices.action: Check the network, then connect again.

notices.title: Connection closed
notices.reason: The hub closed the connection.
notices.action: Connect again to continue.

notices.title: Still reading the DSPi
notices.reason: The DSPi's settings are still being read.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: File not read or written
notices.reason: A file could not be read or written.
notices.action: Check the file and its folder, then try again.

notices.title: AutoEQ update failed
notices.reason: The headphone database could not be updated.
notices.action: Try again later.

notices.title: AutoEQ update paused
notices.reason: The server asked to wait before the next update.
notices.action: Try again later.

notices.title: AutoEQ update failed
notices.reason: The server could not be reached.
notices.action: Check the network connection, then try again.

notices.title: Firmware not installed
notices.reason: This firmware image can leave the DSPi's core voltage too low. Nothing was written.
notices.action: Choose a different firmware image.

notices.title: Confirmation needed
notices.reason: This raises the core voltage above 1.20 V. Nothing was written.
notices.action: Type OVERVOLT to confirm, or keep the current voltage.

notices.title: Not confirmed
notices.reason: This change needs a confirmation, and it was missing, was for another change, or had run out. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Confirm the change again.

notices.title: Outside the limits
notices.reason: The installer's limits profile for this DSPi does not allow that value. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose a value within the limits, or ask the installer to change them.

notices.title: Limits profile unreadable
notices.reason: The limits profile for this DSPi could not be read, so the last good copy of it is in force.
notices.action: Ask the installer to check the limits profile and save it again.

notices.title: Limits profile unreadable
notices.reason: The limits profile for this DSPi could not be read and there is no good copy of it, so no limits are in force.
notices.action: Ask the installer to set the limits profile again.

notices.title: Limits apply here only
notices.reason: The DSPi itself does not know these limits: a control surface, the UART or a console without this profile can still go past them.
notices.action: Set the same profile on every console that controls this DSPi.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: The installer has locked this DSPi on this console: only volume, mute and presets can be changed. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Ask the installer, or unlock with the installer's PIN.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: The installer has locked this DSPi on this console: only volume, mute and presets can be changed. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Ask the installer, or unlock with the installer's PIN.

notices.title: Installer PIN needed
notices.reason: An installer PIN is set for this DSPi on this console, so this needs the Installer unlock. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Unlock with the installer's PIN, then try again.

notices.title: Wrong PIN
notices.reason: That is not the installer's PIN or recovery code for this DSPi.
notices.action: Check the PIN and enter it again.

notices.title: Too many wrong PINs
notices.reason: After several wrong PINs, new attempts are refused for a while.
notices.action: Wait until the time shown, then try again.

notices.title: No installer PIN set
notices.reason: No installer PIN is set for this DSPi on this console, so there is nothing to lock.
notices.action: Set an installer PIN in the Installer mode first.

notices.title: This lock is on this console
notices.reason: This lock is on this console; the DSPi itself is open. It is a lock for everyday use, not a security boundary: another console or tool can still change the DSPi.
notices.action: For real access control, connect the DSPi through a hub and use its roles.

notices.title: Keep the recovery code
notices.reason: The recovery code unlocks this DSPi on this console if the PIN is forgotten. It is shown only now.
notices.action: Write it in the hand-over note and keep it away from the system's users.

notices.title: Only an Admin may write this
notices.reason: This DSPi has a limits profile or an installer lock on its hub, so the hub lets only an Admin write its whole state at once. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Change single settings instead, or connect to the hub as an Admin.

notices.title: Limits could not be checked
notices.reason: The hub could not read this DSPi's state to check the change against its limits profile. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: Locked on the hub
notices.reason: The hub this DSPi is connected through holds its installer lock, so the hub's PIN unlocks it for this console.
notices.action: Enter the installer's PIN for this DSPi on the hub.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: Locked by the installer: only volume, mute and presets can be changed.
notices.action: Unlock with the installer's PIN to change more.

notices.title: Configuration not read
notices.reason: The file is not a DSPi configuration this version reads. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose another file, or update the app if the file came from a newer version.

notices.title: Nothing selected
notices.reason: No part of the configuration was chosen to apply. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose at least one part to apply.

notices.title: Still reading the DSPi
notices.reason: The DSPi's settings have not been read yet.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: Keep these settings?
notices.reason: They go back in {s} s unless you press Keep.
notices.action: Press Keep to keep them, or Revert to go back now.

notices.title: The hub keeps the way back too
notices.reason: The hub puts them back too if this console goes away.
notices.action: Press Keep or Revert here as usual.

notices.title: Something went wrong
notices.reason: The request did not complete.
notices.action: Try again.
